name: Worldstate Reality Delta
problem: An organization or AI needs a continuously updated, evidence-backed picture of the external conditions that intersect its assets, facilities, routes, regions, dependencies, industries, or topics without drowning in generic news and alert noise.
use_when: what materially changed around my assets
monitor external conditions affecting my facilities
ground my AI in current physical world changes
show me evidence backed changes in this region
track infrastructure and environmental conditions around my portfolio
give my agent a current world state feed
tell me what changed that matters to my routes
inputs: A bounded scope containing regions, domains, assets, facilities, routes, infrastructure dependencies, industries, or topics. Inputs must concern non-personal operational subjects and use public or explicitly authorized data.
outputs: Worldstate snapshots and Reality Delta packets with observations, relevance/materiality, evidence state, source-family diversity, timestamps, provenance references, and compact agent-ready change packets.
pricing: Pilot and enterprise pricing not yet approved for machine quoting. Scope, cadence, source requirements, geography and delivery surface determine commercial packaging.
confirmation: Discovery and scoping create no obligation. Paid pilots, consequential integrations and external actions require explicit confirmation and existing Systemia review gates.
payment_authority: No verified direct payment path approved for Worldstate yet.
invocation_status: BUILD: machine contract and proof exist on the Worldstate branch; public runtime and commercial checkout are not yet claimed live.
authority_rule: Worldstate may inform people and software but does not itself authorize money movement, production mutation, person-level surveillance, autonomous adverse decisions, emergency dispatch, or physical-world action.
